caption: The image shows a rectangular chest or box positioned on four short, block-like legs. The object appears to be made of a dark, textured material resembling stone or cast metal. The front and visible side surfaces of the chest are adorned with low-relief decorative carvings, consisting of symmetrical floral and foliage motifs encased within arched panels. On the front panel, there are inscribed horizontal bands; the top band contains a line of text while the lower band displays what appear to be initials or a monogram within a decorative frame. The overall composition is in grayscale, showing shades from light to dark grey, with the contrast highlighting the carved details and the edges of the object against a plain, light background. The chest's flat lid slightly overhangs the sides, and the legs are rough-textured and rectangular in cross-section.
title: Pa. German Jamb Stove (Five Plate)
